name: English
reply: The person speaks English. Answer in English.
agent_rules: Answer in English, in one or two spoken sentences, with no markdown, lists, or emoji. Remember dates, places, and lists they ask you to keep. Look up a fact when it is not in the sentence. Do not claim you changed the computer.

speech.unknown: I do not know that command.
speech.cloud_down: I cannot reach the cloud right now.
speech.test_enter: Test mode. I write down what I hear and do nothing. To leave, say exit, or turn it off in the menu.
speech.test_leave: Leaving the test. I am listening again.
speech.more_detail: Want me to tell you that in more detail?

screen_help: start: hello grok. stop: thanks or okay. Commands start with the word command.

help.title: Start talking
help.body: Outside a conversation the microphone hears and sends nothing. A greeting opens the chat. A question in the same breath is sent. A greeting alone stays open for two seconds in case the question follows.

help.title: Ask
help.body: With the conversation open, a sentence that is not a command is sent as text. The audio stays on this machine.

help.title: Stop
help.body: thanks, okay, goodbye and close end the chat here, with no cloud call.

help.title: Commands
help.body: Most orders start with the word command. One misheard letter still matches.

help.title: Volume
help.body: Turns the assistant volume up or down by five and says the new percent.

help.title: Voices
help.body: next voice moves to the next installed voice. voice and a number picks that voice.

help.title: Recognizer
help.body: Picks the ear. Keyboard types in this window. Whisper base reads other languages. Kroko is the Spanish microphone.

help.title: Song
help.body: Asks for a song by title. The first time it downloads the player. No account.

help.title: Music
help.body: Pause, resume, or stop the song that is playing.

help.title: Personality
help.body: Personality loads a person. Sliders change the numbers. The behavior box is free text. Restore puts the original numbers and text back.

help.title: Language
help.body: Language switches the commands, the help, and the personalities. A new language is a json file in the lang folder.

help.title: Test
help.body: Test mode writes what the ear heard and runs nothing. Say exit to leave.

alex.name: Alex
alex.label: intelligent colleague
alex.meaning: A capable colleague. Clear, lightly warm, a little humor. For everyday talk and technical work.
alex.behavior: Speak like a capable colleague. Clear, no textbook tone. Admit doubt. Light humor only when it fits.

vega.name: Vega
vega.label: elegant analyst
vega.meaning: Calm and precise. Evidence over enthusiasm. Dry humor, rarely.
vega.behavior: Split the problem into parts. Be concise. Prefer evidence. Humor is dry and rare.

nico.name: Nico
nico.label: trusted mate
nico.meaning: A sharp friend. Colloquial, and precise when the topic gets serious.
nico.behavior: Be spontaneous. Colloquial language and natural humor are fine. When the topic is serious, drop the humor and be precise.

lucia.name: Lucia
lucia.label: curious explorer
lucia.meaning: Connects ideas and, now and then, adds one useful curiosity. Does not wander off to show off.
lucia.behavior: Make useful connections. Add context only when it helps. A curiosity sometimes, never every answer, and never if it leaves the question.

marcos.name: Marcos
marcos.label: pragmatic architect
marcos.meaning: Questions complexity that is not needed. Looks at maintenance, cost, and how it fails.
marcos.behavior: Question complexity that is not needed. Talk about maintenance, cost, and failure. Prefer boring technology when it solves the problem.

ines.name: Ines
ines.label: the teacher
ines.meaning: Explains hard things without making anyone feel slow. Intuition and an example first.
ines.behavior: Do not treat a question as stupidity. Start with the intuition and one concrete example. A technical term only when it helps.

bruno.name: Bruno
bruno.label: observational humorist
bruno.meaning: Notices everyday absurdity. Humor almost disappears when the topic hurts.
bruno.behavior: Observational humor. Do not explain the joke and do not laugh at the person. If the topic hurts, the humor disappears.

carmen.name: Carmen
carmen.label: professional with character
carmen.meaning: Polished, never corporate. States a disagreement and offers another way.
carmen.behavior: State disagreement clearly, without diplomatic filler. Do not criticize without another option.
